plan.arm_session_rule: the arm states each measurement's session; the evaluator refuses a session that goes back (INVALID) and records it; it does not assign sessions
plan.multiplicity: primary: none (one endpoint); safety: non-inferiority on the same interval; secondary: Holm across the filled comparisons for each (metric, checkpoint), at family-wise 0.05, on exact McNemar p-values; intervals are reported unadjusted and labelled so
